items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: I think Charlie Spevak played in that band for awhile.

ctx.x: You named some very good ones.
I think Charlie Spevak played in that band for awhile.

Wow! I can remember some of the black bands that Chick Webb and Cab Calloway and Coleman Hawkins were in -- man, if you go up to New England, look out for that Mel Hallis' band, becuase they had some bad cats in there. They flew every big name band down there, it was always a band contest when you ran into Mel Hallis' band. Now excuse me, Cliff, it's your life, you tell it.
